card.name: Verbs reporting outcomes after exposure
card.fires_on: The main verb right after a subject who took a drug or overdose, such as "experienced" or "had", just before the reported outcome. Mostly in overdose and interaction passages.

modes.label: Overdose outcome verb
modes.description: "experienced" or "had" after a patient or person who took a large dose.
modes.example: Most patients who overdosed<< experienced>> no adverse reactions or recovered fully from the

modes.label: Drug effect verb
modes.description: "had" or "produced" after a drug name, before "no effect" or a study result.
modes.example: Bacterial and mammalian mutagenicity studies using carbamazepine<< produced>> negative results.

card.plain: It marks the verb that introduces what happened to patients after a drug exposure or overdose.
